bullets.text: In Tiruvallur district, about 40 students fell ill after a dead lizard was found in government school sambar, prompting authorities to relieve two cooks.
In Adyar, a six-member gang waylaid a pharmaceutical firm employee at knifepoint and robbed him of Rs 24 lakh near the Ambika Appalam signal.
The Greater Chennai Corporation identified 219 vulnerable waterlogging locations across the city and arranged pump deployments ahead of the monsoon.
The Water Resources Department expedited monsoon clearing works while water hyacinth remains a major challenge raised by residents.
Power supply will be suspended in Taramani areas including MGR Film City and WPT College for maintenance work on Saturday.
Ramancheri residents staged a protest demanding the construction of an overbridge on the national highway, involving about 100 participants.
Police are investigating a private factory near Gummidipoondi for transporting gravel soil using fake bills.
Residents discovered ancient deity idols during reconstruction work at the 500-year-old dilapidated Agneeswarar temple in Thiruvai village.
Operational data centre capacity in India crossed 1,700 MW in 2025 with strong year-on-year growth and an AI-driven pipeline reaching up to 10 GW by 2030.
CPM leader Shanmugam claimed the TVK government did not bring the Gem Veeramani case to light and noted a POCSO judge was key.
CPM state secretary Shanmugam stated that the POCSO case against Gem Veeramani was not properly investigated during the previous DMK regime.
Chief Minister Vijay announced party positions as deputy general secretaries for 11 former AIADMK ministers who recently joined TVK.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to inaugurate the Poonamallee to Vadapalani phase II metro rail line on October 11.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Chief Minister Vijay will participate together on the same stage for the Poonamallee-Vadapalani metro launch.
The new 14.6 km metro corridor from Poonamallee Bypass to Vadapalani will open to reduce traffic congestion in Chennai.
